capabilities: show related notes for the open note in a sidebar
search the vault by meaning in natural language
insert search results as links to the current note
extras: The plugin is free, works fully offline after install, and the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: There are some other plugins in this space, each with their own strengths and approaches.
motivation: The author wants notes never to be orphaned, to rediscover past writing on the same topic (especially while journaling), and to write without the chore of manual linking.
problem: Obsidian search matches words, so notes that discuss the same topic with different wording or titles stay hidden, and unlinked notes feel orphaned.
summary: Semantic search and related-notes sidebar powered by a tiny on-device AI model, surfacing notes similar in meaning without needing links.
